forecast_gold_rule: An unqualified future outcome is Unsupported against a forecast-only Source; an explicit attribution of that forecast is Supported, using the same exact Source.
passage_separation: Each logical source is a separate short Markdown Document, so complete-summary cases span two to four distinct Documents/Passages rather than relying on a parser to split adjacent short paragraphs.
scope_rule: Each case profile materializes its listed Documents only. Importing the whole bank would invalidate missing-evidence gold.
